officialSources.title: NEVI Formula Program Fact Sheet
officialSources.evidenceText: FHWA states that NEVI funds are not available to a state for obligation until the state's plan is submitted and approved, that the Federal share is 80%, and that eligible projects must be directly related to vehicle charging and publicly accessible or available to commercial motor vehicle operators from more than one company. officialSources.title: 23 U.S.C. 151 - National electric vehicle infrastructure program
officialSources.owner: Office of the Law Revision Counsel

officialSources.title: 23 CFR Part 680 - National Electric Vehicle Infrastructure Standards and Requirements
officialSources.evidenceText: Federal NEVI standards require, among other items, at least four network-connected DCFC ports along Alternative Fuel Corridors, at least 150 kW per DCFC port, public availability, payment access, and five years of operation and maintenance compliance. ([eCFR][5])

officialSources.title: South Dakota 2026-2029 Statewide Transportation Improvement Program Book

officialSources.title: National Electric Vehicle Infrastructure Formula Program
